newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stocks end steady in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stocks end steady in light trade.

text.p: Singapore shares ended steady in light Monday trade, buoyed by gains in selected blue-chips and selected electronic counters, dealers said.
"The market was firm but on low volume," a dealer with a local institution said. "I think it will trade sideways for now. We have to watch its performance in the next one to two days."

Dealers said sentiment for electronic stocks like Uraco and Sunright firmed in tandem with Creative. Creative led gainers, rising $1.70 to S$12.20 after electronic shares in the U.S. traded heavily in anticipation of strong year-end festive demand. The SES electronic index rose 1.65 points to 86.89.
The Straits Times Industrials Index ended 6.74 points up at 2,197.13. Turnover was moderate at 91.7 million shares with gainers leading losers by 177 to 156.

Dealers said forced selling by punters and poor sentiment on Ossia led the sports-goods wholesaler to shed S$0.025 to end at a new low of S$0.525 in heavy volume against its initial offer price of S$0.61 last month.

Hong Kong's Dairy Farm, which ended unchanged at US$0.775, led the actives with 5.1 million shares on some brokers' buy recommendations. Insurance company Great Eastern fell S$0.40 to S$24.50 on 3,000 lots. -- Angela Tan (65 8703083) REUTER
